find_audio_files: recursively find all audio files in a directory and return their paths with duration metadata
create_audioset_dataset: create an Audioset dataset from a list of audio files with configurable length stride and padding
load_audio_with_offset: load an audio file with a specific offset and frame count using torchaudio
apply_augmentation_to_audio: apply an augmentation function to audio data when loading from the Audioset dataset
pad_audio_tensor: pad an audio tensor to a specified length using torch functional padding
